CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(NextReviewDate__c), "Review Required",
IF( NextReviewDate__c < TODAY(), "Overdue",
IF( NextReviewDate__c = TODAY(), "Review Required",
IF( NextReviewDate__c <= TODAY() + 60, "Due Soon", "Up to date" ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically indicates the governance review status based on the next scheduled review date.
CustomField.label: Review Status
